description: Add a job to the user's Job Tracker pipeline (the same tracker shown at /job-tracker, listed by list_tracked_jobs). Use after import_job_from_url / rewrite_cv_for_job to record that the user is pursuing a role. title and company are required; status defaults to "Saved" (valid: Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, Not Offered, Accepted). Pass jd_id to link the imported JD and linkedCvId to link a generated CV/résumé. Returns the new tracker_id.

jd_id.description: jd_id from import_job_from_url, to link the imported JD.

linkedCoverLetterId.description: Generated cover-letter id to link (camelCase key — matches the backend contract).

linkedCvId.description: Generated CV/résumé id to link (camelCase key — matches the backend contract).

name: track_job
